name: Gunpowder as an energetic material
summary: The Chinese military manual Wujing zongyao, completed in 1044, recorded gunpowder mixtures used in incendiary and explosive weapons, a secure early written record of the material.
description: A documented energetic material was codified in the 1044 Wujing zongyao and used in subsequent incendiary and explosive applications.
tier_reason: The controllable material supports subsequent military, mining and pyrotechnic technologies over generations.
why: The Song court faced strong northern neighbours and commissioned the manual to gather useful military techniques.

date.basis: The named source records this distinct community episode; public accounts provide awareness rather than acceptance.
